overrides: brace-expansion 4.0.0 to 5.0.8 has a high-severity denial of service via unbounded
intermediate arrays (GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895). The vulnerable copy is not ours: it arrives
through aws-cdk-lib > minimatch, so npm audit fix cannot reach it and there is nothing to
wait for on our side. 5.0.9 is the patch. Remove this override once aws-cdk-lib ships a
minimatch that depends on it directly.
